verdict.rationale: Pylon's omnichannel support is documented as Slack, Email, Microsoft Teams, Chat Widget, and Forms (pylon-docs-70, pylon-docs-24), with no mention of telephony/voice channels, speech-to-text, or text-to-speech capabilities anywhere in the evidence pack. Voice support is a plausible axis for a support platform, but there is no documentation of a phone channel, so this is 'none' rather than 'na'.
